personalities.name: The Analyst
personalities.description: Some would say you’re a skeptic, but you say you’re just immune to hype. For you, quality comes first, and you need proof that AI can deliver to your standards.

personalities.name: The Experimenter
personalities.description: You’re figuring how AI fits into your workflow, one test at a time. You might not have all the answers yet, but curiosity is driving you forwards.

personalities.name: The Innovator
personalities.description: You’re clear on AI’s potential and you’re forging a new approach with AI as part of your brand roadmap.

questions.label: The no-risk test
questions.text: You have a no-risk chance to test anything about your brand. What do you test?

answers.content: A known variable that you’ve always wanted to understand better.
Something unexpected, just to see what happens.
An existing brand idea pushed into new territory, to see how far it can go.

questions.label: The tool decision
questions.text: Your team needs a new tool. There are several options on the table. How do you choose the right one?

answers.content: Research is key. Read product documentation, explore case studies, and – most importantly – see what other users have to say.
Hands-on testing is the way to go. Nothing compares to trying things for yourself. Test a few options and compare the results.
Think beyond the immediate need. Consider which option could create the most value for your brand or impact the goals of other teams.

questions.label: The unexpected result
questions.text: The lab results are in. Your AI experiment has produced something unexpected. You…

answers.content: Look back through your data and try to figure out what happened.
Run the experiment again to see if you get the same result.
Take what you learned and consider where else these results might be useful.
